versions.changelog: Bilingual SKILL.md: English-first for global accessibility

- Initial release of yt2gdrive.
- Syncs latest audio (mp3) or video (mp4) from specified YouTube channels to Google Drive using rclone.
- Supports flexible configuration via environment variables (media mode, file locations, filters, and format/quality settings).
- Includes options for scheduled syncing (daily macOS launchd setup).
- Prevents duplicate downloads, auto-cleans old files, and can limit by upload bandwidth and video length.
- Comprehensive error logging and dry-run mode for safe testing.
